questions: How long have the mouth ulcers been present, and do you have any other symptoms like fever, weight loss, or swollen lymph nodes?
Have you noticed any new skin rash, redness of the eyes, or painful genital sores in the last month?
Have you noticed any enlarged, tender lymph nodes (like in your neck, armpits, or groin) since these symptoms started?
Have you noticed small blisters or painful raw areas on your lips or inside your mouth that start as blisters and then rupture (i.e., vesicles/erosions rather than simple round “canker” ulcers)?
Have you started any new medications in the last 1–3 months (including antibiotics, NSAIDs like ibuprofen, or drugs for gout), and did the rash/ulcers begin after starting them?
Have you had any **painful blisters or sores on your genitals** (penis/scrotum or around the anus) even if they were not “genital sores” you noticed?
Do you have painful blisters or sores on your palms or soles, and have you noticed any rash in the same areas?
Have you had any sore throat, painful swallowing, or swollen, generalized lymph nodes (not just in the neck/armpits/groin) along with the mouth ulcers?
Have you had any recent unprotected sex or shared needles in the 2–8 weeks before the rash and mouth ulcers started?
Have you had swollen lymph nodes in more than one body area (e.g., neck and armpits at the same time), and if so where and since when?
answers: The mouth ulcers have been present for about **2 weeks**. I don’t know about swollen lymph nodes, and I **haven’t had fever** or **weight loss** that I can tell.
Yes, I’ve had **new skin rash/redness** over the last month. I don’t know about **redness of the eyes**, and I don’t have **painful genital sores**.
I’m not sure—I haven’t noticed any **enlarged or tender lymph nodes** in my neck, armpits, or groin.
Yes. The sores in my mouth and lips are **painful**, and they seem to **start like small blisters** and then turn into **raw areas** after they break.
I **haven’t started any new medications** in the last 1–3 months, so I can’t say the rash/ulcers started after a new medicine.
No, I don’t have **painful blisters or sores** on my genitals or around the anus.
I don’t know about my **palms or soles**. I haven’t noticed a rash in the same areas as that, so I can’t say it’s there.
I don’t have a sore throat or **painful swallowing**. I’m not aware of **swollen generalized lymph nodes** along with the mouth ulcers.
No. I haven’t had **unprotected sex** and I haven’t shared needles in the 2–8 weeks before the rash and mouth ulcers started.
I’m not sure. I haven’t noticed **swollen lymph nodes in more than one area** (like neck and armpits together), so I can’t say where or since when.
